newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CSM forecasts further profit growth.
newsitem.headline: CSM forecasts further profit growth.

text.p: Dutch food group CSM NV said on Tuesday net profits would continue to grow during the current 1996/97 financial year ending September 30.
"Overall, CSM expects its net profits to show a further rise in the current financial year, 1996/97," it said in a statement.
The company said last November that 1995/96 net profit rose by 8.1 percent to 201.6 million guilders.
CSM said that it expected to invest some 150 million guilders in existing activities during the current financial year, to be financed entirely from operational cash flow.
